scale.risk: 1 is low risk; 5 is high risk

levers.lever: Authorize and lock the 90-day measurement baseline
levers.rationale: Every optimization and success claim depends on a comparable baseline.
levers.acceptance: all required sources either populated or explicitly waived

levers.lever: Audit and correct GBP fields using verified business facts
levers.rationale: Accuracy and completeness are foundational local signals; edits can create suspension risk if facts are wrong.
levers.acceptance: field-by-field evidence and rollback snapshot approved

levers.lever: Publish one evidence-rich Burlington service-area page
levers.rationale: Creates a focused local organic destination without doorway-page expansion.
levers.acceptance: coverage, unique proof, accessibility, schema and CWV checks pass

levers.rationale: Authentic review velocity can improve trust; CASL and platform controls raise risk.
levers.acceptance: consent, suppression, audit, expiry and no-gating tests pass

levers.lever: Publish two evidence-backed local articles per month
levers.rationale: Builds topical and local relevance when content answers real audience needs.
levers.acceptance: source, originality, local relevance and CTA checks pass

levers.lever: Pitch five individually researched local education partnerships
levers.rationale: Earned authority is valuable but outcomes and eligibility are uncertain.
levers.acceptance: five approved one-to-one pitches; no bulk automation

levers.lever: Expand to secondary location pages only after demand and proof gates
levers.rationale: Premature templated pages risk thin or doorway content.
levers.acceptance: query demand, verified coverage and distinct proof exist per location
